m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Who leads us? None other than the grim, ghastly, Ghalak Poisonthorn! His tent is right there!
A Wizard!? This is an unexpected delight. I'll enjoy shredding your skin and leaving it for Warlord Kravenly. He'll be here soon.
Kravenly the Hunter will oversee the completion of the Siege Engines. We will fling Kermes Fire and burn down the Last Wood!
He's also overseeing the development of wicked new arms in the Weapons Tent, which will crush the Burrower forces!
Curse you, Light Child! Curse you and your pet and your mount, too! You'll never find the Weapons Tent until it's too late!
<ITALICS>Maybe you should look around and see if you can find the Weapons Tent and see what they are up to. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>There are some ominous sounds of weapon grinding and fitful whines coming from this tent. </ITALICS>
Light Bringer... I sting your heart!
<ITALICS>They are transforming Bumbler drones into Goliaths here! </ITALICS>
Spellbinder, what news have you brought us?
We know that Shadow Weavers and Yellow Jackets have been massing in Camp Havoc, just beyond our borders.
They are going to retaliate for our attack on the Apidae Village. The Spellbinder could infiltrate Camp Havoc to learn their plans.
You can sneak into Havoc via our hidden portal that leads directly into their camp.
They know nothing of it, so you will have surprise.
It's a strong idea. Force the Night Flames to reveal their leader to you. He'll have the information we need!
Sneak into Camp Havoc through our portal. Force the Night Flames to reveal their leader, and track him down!
